# Sakanak — سكنك

> Egypt's #1 roommate finder and rooms-for-rent platform. Verified profiles, smart matching, zero broker commission. Bilingual (English + Arabic) for Cairo, Giza, Alexandria and across Egypt.

Sakanak (سكنك) connects renters and roommates directly. Hosts list rooms or shared apartments; seekers browse, match, chat after mutual viewing confirmation, and book viewings. All users are ID-verified.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, featured rooms, AI room finder.
- [Browse Rooms](/rooms): Verified rooms and shared apartments across Egypt.
- [List a Room](/list-room): Hosts publish a listing with photos, location and pricing.
- [How It Works](/how-it-works): Step-by-step guide for seekers and hosts.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about safety, fees, verification.
- [Safety Tips](/safety-tips): Guidance for safe in-person viewings and communication.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach support.
- [Blog](/blog): Renting tips, area guides, student housing advice.
